description: This file defines a normalizer service class that provides methods to normalize data objects and arrays into a standard format. It uses a trait for normalization functionality and appears to be part of a Human Resource Management system (OrangeHRM).

classes.name: NormalizerService
classes.description: A service class providing methods to normalize data models and arrays within the OrangeHRM Core system.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes a single data object or scalar based on the specified model class.

methods.name: normalizeArray
methods.description: Normalizes an array of data items based on the specified model class.
